headline: AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D bundle for $1,109.99 includes X870E mobo, 32GB DDR5, AIO cooler & game
summary: Newegg's bundle offers nearly $300 in savings on a high-end AMD gaming PC build, featuring the Ryzen 7 9800X3D CPU, an Asus TUF X870E motherboard, 32GB DDR5 RAM, a 240mm AIO cooler, and a free game.
details: Newegg is offering an AMD bundle featuring the Ryzen 7 9800X3D, an Asus TUF X870E motherboard, and 32GB of Corsair Vengeance RGB DDR5-6000 RAM for $1,109.99. This deal provides savings of nearly $300 compared to purchasing components separately, making it an attractive option for high-end gaming PC builders.

The Ryzen 7 9800X3D is an 8-core, 16-thread processor built on AMD’s Zen 5 architecture, boasting a 4.7 GHz base clock and up to 5.2 GHz boost. Its 3D V-Cache technology is a key feature, significantly lowering latency and boosting overall gaming performance, positioning it as a top choice for high-end gaming CPUs.

The Asus TUF Gaming X870E-Plus motherboard is a suitable pairing, offering premium features like a robust power delivery system and dual PCIe 5.0 M.2 SSD slots. It also includes Wi-Fi 7, 2.5Gb Ethernet, dual USB4 (40Gbps) Type-C ports, and a front USB 20Gbps Type-C connector with 30W PD Fast-charge.

The bundle includes a Corsair Vengeance RGB kit with two 16GB DDR5 modules at 6000 MT/s and CL36 timings, supporting both Intel XMP and AMD EXPO profiles. Additionally, a 240mm Cooler Master AIO liquid cooler and a copy of Onimusha: Way of the Sword are included as free gifts.

Individually, the Ryzen 7 9800X3D is $469, the Corsair RAM is $499.99, and the Asus motherboard is $289.99. With the CPU cooler ($79.99) and game ($69.99) added, the total value is around $1,408.96, confirming the bundle's significant $300 saving.
